coverImageAlt: Rough stone moving through cyan shaping gates into a stable stack of fitted blocks.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: a rough, shapeless idea stone passes through a rigorous stepped jig and emerges as a stable foundation of precisely fitted requirement blocks
Scene/backdrop: warm paper workshop plane fading into a quiet navy backdrop
Subject: one left-to-right transformation apparatus with an irregular slate stone at the entrance, calibrated cyan shaping stages, and a clean load-bearing block foundation at the exit; one orange verification pin locks the final assembly
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with hand-built workshop objects and crisp dimensional detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; clear single transformation path; strong silhouettes and ample negative space; crop-safe focal subject; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: rigorous, reassuring, quietly methodical, restrained backlighting
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: carved stone, matte enamel, pale wood, fibrous paper, soft shadows
Constraints: every block and surface blank and unmarked; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, documents covered in marks, screens, dashboards, flowchart arrows, decorative clutter
